passages.text: Australina pusilla, the small shade nettle, is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae, native to eastern Australia, and New Zealand. A highly variable perennial herb reaching {{cvt|50|cm|in}}, it is often found growing alongside shady streams.

Subtaxa
The following subspecies are accepted:
Australina pusilla subsp. muelleri {{small|(Wedd.) Friis & Wilmot-Dear}} – Queensland, New South Wales, Victoria, Tasmania
Australina pusilla subsp. pusilla – New South Wales, Victoria, Tasmania, North Island, South Island
